FedEx Ship Manager ™ at fedex.com - User Guide
1Nov 2023
It’s a new shipping tool designed around what you, the customer, said you need. Essentially it’s a fresh, simplified way to ship –– noclutter, no fuss, just an easy experience with features built to help.
What is the FedEx Ship Manager™ at fedex.com?
Easily accessible from any desktop by multiple users
High-performing shipping features and brand-new ones Automatic updates so you get the latest features as soon as they’re released 
Sleek, polished design

A few shipment status examples are:DraftIncomplete: Additional information neededExpired:The shipping date has expired and a newdate needs to be pickedReady to finalize: Shipment complete and needs to be finalizedFailed to finalize: An error occurred and couldn’t be finalized
Finalized: Shipment is completeNot printed: Shipment is complete, but documents need to be printed
After you’ve shipped, it’s nice to keep an eye on things –– you can do this in SHIPMENTS. There’s a complete list of your shipments, status details, and other key details.
User guide > manage your shipment
You can customize the shipment view and columns to suit how you ship and if you want to switch back to the original view, click 'Default'.
